score_definition: log1p(u_mean) minus a validation-fitted quadratic function of log1p(observed_motion); fit does not use ADE/FDE or future ground truth.
score_model_scope: Existing reliability results use a frozen three-seed zero-scene trajectory-only ensemble, not the joint checkpoint under audit.

test_context.interpretation: Adjusted uncertainty has a positive but modest test association with trajectory error; it is weaker than raw uncertainty/motion and not evident in validation global Spearman. Do not treat the test association as a training-loss result.

adjusted_u_vs_joint_trajectory_ade.reason: No aligned per-sample adjusted-u and joint-checkpoint prediction/error artifact was saved.

adjusted_u_vs_training_trajectory_loss.reason: No per-sample training trajectory losses or aligned training adjusted-u values were persisted; the reliability artifact contains aggregate validation/test summaries only.

weighting_recommendation: Reliability-aware trajectory weighting is a later controlled candidate, not the first fix. First generate training-only or cross-fitted uncertainty scores and verify their association with per-sample joint trajectory loss without using test labels; validate whether high uncertainty should upweight hard examples or downweight unreliable targets.
